title: Nested upper truncations and their boundary counits
statement:
Let $\mathcal U$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with an arbitrary t-structure $t$ [def-weil-t-structure]. Use its truncation functors and counits $\epsilon_s(K):\tau^{\le s}K\to K$ [lem-weil-heart-short-exact-triangles]. For every $K\in\mathcal U$ the following hold.
1. For integers $r\le s$, the morphism
$$\tau^{\le r}(\epsilon_s(K)):\tau^{\le r}\tau^{\le s}K\longrightarrow\tau^{\le r}K$$
is an isomorphism.
2. If $a\in\mathbf Z$ and $K\in\mathcal U^{\ge a}$, then $\tau^{\le a-1}K$ is a zero object.
3. If $b\in\mathbf Z$ and $K\in\mathcal U^{\le b}$, then $\epsilon_b(K):\tau^{\le b}K\to K$ is an isomorphism.
No boundedness or nondegeneracy of $t$ is assumed.

source.place: Proposition 1.3.3(i) and paragraph 1.3.4, pp. 29-30 (PDF pp. 30-31): nested truncations and vanishing/identity criteria.
